body_markdown:
*Applications will be accepted through October 28*


TOPEKA, Kan., - October 12, 2026– The Evergy Green Team will host **youth rifle deer hunts December 2 - 14** . Hunts will be conducted at **Jeffrey Energy Center** , 25905 Jeffrey Rd, St. Marys, Kan., during the early firearm deer season. Due to the highly supervised and educational nature of the hunts, youths aged 13 – 17 with little or no deer hunting experience are invited to apply. **Applications will be accepted through Friday, October 28.** Requests for applications should be sent toGreenTeam@evergy.com .


The hunt is part of Evergy’s commitment to environmental education, conservation stewardship and community engagement. It provides hands-on opportunities for young people to learn about wildlife management, ethical hunting practices and habitat conservation.


**All youth hunters must first attend a mandatory orientation session Saturday, November 14** at Jeffrey Energy Center. Organizers will instruct hunters on safety, deer biology and assist youths with sighting in rifles. Hunters will then be allowed to attend the youth deer hunts **December 2 - 14.**


Other important items of note include:


- Each young hunter must be accompanied by an adult mentor to participate.
- Hunts will take place in the early morning or late afternoon.
- A limited number of slots will be awarded to applicants, with priority to those with little or no deer hunting experience.
- Hunting will be conducted from blinds, and participants will be led by volunteer, experienced hunters.
- Youth hunters are encouraged to bring their own rifle, but one can be provided if needed.
- Every hunter must have a Unit 9 deer permit from the Kansas Department of Wildlife and Parks. Hunters 16 and older must also possess a hunting license and hunter education certificate or an apprentice license for those who do not have a hunter education certificate.


The Green Team’s annual youth deer hunts are conducted in partnership with the Kansas Department of Wildlife and Parks and are designed to provide an opportunity to educate youths about wildlife conservation principles, habitat protection, as well as safe and sustainable harvest practices. The hunts are safe and fun hunting experiences focused on engaging inexperienced hunters, in an area where the odds of success are high due to the abundance of deer.


**About Evergy**
